Home/Web Portal Development

Give Every User Their Own Front Door

A portal replaces the email threads, spreadsheets and phone calls your business currently runs on, with one secure place where each user sees exactly their own work.

Get a Free Quote

One Platform, Many Kinds of User

Portals are what you build when a website is not enough: customers checking orders, partners submitting claims, staff approving requests, all in one system with different permissions.

We design the role model first — who can see what, who can approve what — because that decision shapes every screen that follows.

  • Role-based access designed before the screens
  • Single sign-on and multi-factor authentication
  • Live data from the systems you already run
  • Audit trails for anything that matters legally

Security Is a Design Decision, Not a Checklist

Portals hold the data you least want leaked. Access control has to be enforced on the server for every request, not merely hidden in the interface.

We build permissions into the data layer, encrypt what needs encrypting, log access to sensitive records, and keep dependencies patched after launch.

Talk to Us

Integrate, Do Not Duplicate

A portal that keeps its own copy of your customer data will be wrong within a month. It should read from the systems that already own that information.

We integrate with your CRM, ERP, accounting and support tools so the portal shows one version of the truth rather than becoming another silo.

Process

How We Deliver

Web Design Lane believes in transparency every step of the way, keeping you in the loop with every executed plan.

Discovery

We get to know your brand, your goals, and the audience you intend to reach through conversations and discovery calls.

Strategy & Planning

We draft a tailored action plan with clear deliverables, timelines, KPIs, and the tools and platforms we will use.

Design & Build

Our team sets the plan in motion, and you are updated on progress at every stage of the build.

Launch & Support

We make every necessary retouch before launch. Only when you are satisfied do we go live — then we stay on for ongoing improvements.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

How long does a portal take to build?

Most run three to six months. We usually ship a focused first release covering the highest-value workflow, then extend from there.

Can it connect to our existing systems?

Yes. If the system has an API or a supported export, we can integrate with it. We confirm this during discovery before committing to a scope.

How do you handle user permissions?

Role-based access control designed up front, enforced server-side on every request, with an audit trail on sensitive actions.

Who hosts the finished portal?

Your cloud account, or one we manage for you. Either way you own the code and the data outright.

Still Running Operations Through Spreadsheets?

Describe the process and we will map what a portal would replace, and what it would save.
